rules.why: any engine or kernel change: frontier logits at every benchmarked context
touches a decode / single-row path: prefill-frontier logits do not exercise it
touches indexer or routing: selections must not move
file is compiled into the NVIDIA build: guard with GGML_USE_HIP / DS4_ROCM_BUILD or measure on CUDA
looks like an opt-in default being flipped: run ak ledger check-promote
touches SSD streaming / expert cache: run a streaming config, not only resident
